mapper.select: SELECT status, score, hint_count AS hintCount FROM game_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId}

SELECT h.id AS hintId, h.hint_order AS hintOrder, h.content FROM game_sessions gs INNER JOIN case_hints h ON h.case_id = gs.case_id LEFT JOIN hint_history hh ON hh.hint_id = h.id AND hh.session_id = gs.id WHERE gs.id = #{sessionId} AND hh.hint_id IS NULL ORDER BY h.hint_order LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE game_sessions SET score = score - 5, hint_count = hint_count + 1 WHERE id = #{sessionId}
